text: Swimming is an excellent form of exercise that provides a comprehensive workout for the entire body. One of the most satisfying aspects of swimming is the ability to monitor progress. For beginners, starting with a set of laps can be an effective way to develop endurance. As one's swimming skills progress, one can gradually increase the number of laps performed. Goggles are not necessary for beginners, as water contact is not required for lap swimming. To maximize the benefits of swimming, focus on becoming comfortable in the water and maintaining a steady pace.
